items.title: Alignment Control
items.summary: Align, distribute and position the selected layers, as a button row or a 3×3 grid.

items.title: Animation Timeline
items.summary: Arrange clips and keyframes on tracks, with a ruler and playhead.

items.title: Browser Bar
items.summary: Back, forward, reload and an address field that adapt to the space they have.

items.title: Burning Text
items.summary: A word with flames rising from its letter strokes.

items.title: Canvas Toolbar
items.summary: A design tool's toolbar with Pointer and Hand tools, custom tools, actions and shortcut tooltips.

items.title: Canvas Viewport
items.summary: An infinite canvas with pan, zoom at the pointer, zoom to fit and selection outlines.

items.title: Color Picker
items.summary: A fill-style colour row whose swatch opens a picker with sliders, formats and swatches.

items.title: Command Menu
items.summary: Find screens and run workspace actions from one searchable palette.

items.title: Context Menu
items.summary: Right-click actions for anything, with a visible button that opens the same menu.

items.title: Contour Field
items.summary: Drifting topographic lines that rise around the pointer.

items.title: Daily Task List
items.summary: A day's tasks with capture, editing, ordering, completion and undo already wired together.

items.title: Easing Curve Editor
items.summary: Shape a cubic Bézier easing with two handles, presets and exact fields.

items.title: Ember Glow
items.summary: A slow drift of light and grain along the bottom edge of a surface.

items.title: Image Picker
items.summary: Choose, drop, paste or link an image from a compact row, with upload progress and retry.

items.title: Inline Edit
items.summary: Rename something in place, with explicit save and cancel.

items.title: Inspector Field
items.summary: One property row for a design tool: a label and a right-aligned control.

items.title: Layers Panel
items.summary: A design tool's layer tree: nested frames with search, selection, reorder and toggles.

items.title: Like Burst
items.summary: A like or favorite toggle with an optional rolling count.

items.title: Motion Inspector
items.summary: Edit how a selected item animates, as an easing curve or a spring.

items.title: Notification Stack
items.summary: A layered deck of notifications that fans out into a spaced list.

items.title: Number Field
items.summary: Type, step or drag a number, as an input or a slider.

items.title: Number Ticker
items.summary: Digits that roll into place as a number changes.

items.title: Onboarding Steps
items.summary: Set up a workspace with an optional teammate invitation.

items.title: Orbit Field
items.summary: Concentric rings of dots or icons orbit a customizable center.

items.title: Plan Switcher
items.summary: Compare plan features and monthly or yearly billing.

items.title: Playback Controls
items.summary: Play, rewind, seek and set the volume of anything your app plays.

items.title: Property Inspector
items.summary: Grouped properties for whatever is selected on a design canvas.

items.title: Pulse Grid
items.summary: A field of dots that carries a double ripple across a surface.

items.title: Resizable Panels
items.summary: Panels with exact pixel sizes, limits, keyboard resizing and Escape to cancel a drag.

items.title: Resize Handles
items.summary: Handles on a selected object that report live sizes and commit once per resize.

items.title: Screen Frame
items.summary: One app screen on a design canvas: name, status, preview and actions.

items.title: Sortable List
items.summary: Reorder your app's items by dragging or with move buttons, and recover when a save fails.

items.title: Split Number Field
items.summary: One number that splits into linked sides or corners, such as padding or radius.

items.title: Stateful Button
items.summary: A button that follows an action through loading, confirmation, and retry.

items.title: Upload Dropzone
items.summary: Select or drop files and track each upload through completion or retry.

items.title: Version Comparison
items.summary: Pick any two design versions, compare them and choose one.

items.title: XY Pad
items.summary: Set two numbers with one draggable point, with a field for each axis.
